content.text: Greater Oklahoma City A Better Living.A Better Life. Greater Oklahoma City A Better Living.A Better Life. Oklahoma City is a thriving metropolis with a low cost of living, short commute times, big-league quality of life and a diversified economy. Through multiple resident-led tax initiatives called MAPS, Oklahoma City is bursting with new development, bettering its infrastructure and schools and creating new quality-of-life additions to the city that are wowing longtime citizens and drawing attention and visitors from around the country. With thrilling sports action, world-class museums, entertainment, shopping and dining at more than a dozen different districts, the energy to continue to grow, build and create is pumping all around town. Featured Jobs Did you know Oklahoma City has one of the most diversified economies in the United States? A quick look at our job boards will show you that no matter your expertise, our community has a place for you. You can search by job type or simply view all jobs to see what opportunities await you in OKC. View All Jobs Software and Cybersecurity Health Care Aerospace A place for all Whether in an international grocery store that carries that hard to find item that reminds you of home or a religious center that gives you a sense of community, Oklahoma City is surprisingly diverse when it comes to its cultural options. Entertainment options galore Whether it is whitewater rafting in the heart of downtown, world-class art exhibits or big-league action with the Thunder, Oklahoma City has diverse entertainment options for all ages. And people are noticing—in fact, Time Magazine recognized Oklahoma City as a “Best Place to Go” last year. Oklahoma boasts diverse terrain Most people who have never visited our great state picture nothing but flat plains as far as the eye can see. However, with 11 different ecoregions, Oklahoma actually sports the nation’s most diverse terrain. That is right, the Sooner State is home to mountains, swamps, prairies, forests and more. Oklahoma City’s population has grown twice as fast as the national average One thing that always surprises newcomers to Oklahoma City is just how big it is. OKC is a major metropolitan city with more than 1.4 million people calling it home. In fact, Oklahoma City is one of only 14 cities in the U.S. to gain more than 100,000 new residents over the last decade. Providing excellence in education Five high schools in the Oklahoma City school district received gold or silver badge awards in the most recent U.S. News & World Report Best High Schools Ranking. In fact, 11 of the top 15 schools in Oklahoma are located in the metro area, making excellence in learning more accessible than ever. Sunshine central While severe weather in Oklahoma City gets the headlines, the metro actually has an average of 235 sunny days a year. In fact, U.S. News and World Reports ranked OKC as a top-eight location for “Best Places to Live in the U.S. for Weather.” Resource Links View All Resources See our Welcome Guide Sign Up for the Better Life Watch our Relocation Video View All Resources Feb 12, 2026 Oklahoma City’s culinary momentum earns national attention Jan 29, 2026 AAR expansion brings new jobs and added capacity to OKC aviation Jan 23, 2026 2025 by the Numbers: Measurable Momentum for Oklahoma City See All News Why I love OKC The ease with which I have been able to find my niche in OKC, both in my professional endeavors and my community work. Having left behind an established professional and community network, I was worried about reestablishing that in OKC. However, what I found was that people were willing to help connect me to opportunities at every turn. The community wanted to help plug me in and find my niche.
